'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Steve Harpster LS You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''SPEEDER BOWL-XL'''. Username '''HARPSTER'''. Line 1 Tatooine: Slave Quarters → start [[You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed]] (Profit archetype). L39 Strike Planning (V) (sheet Strike Force).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Username:''' HARPSTER
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
